data.description:
The suite reports 7,444 tests. Most are parametrization cells: a few hundred test functions expanded over form-count by dialect by difficulty grids. Valerie wants consolidation via property-based and parametric tests.

Approach: replace the fixed 200-generated-forms-per-dialect grids with hypothesis property tests. The universal properties are: parse(render(form)) == form; same seed and spec give identical output; containment relation preserved through every archetype and injector; admission rejects undeclared pairings. Hypothesis generates and shrinks counterexamples, which finds edge cases a fixed sample cannot. Keep a small set of hand-picked example tests per dialect for readability. Keep the frozen-suite rerun test but mark it slow so the default run stays fast.

Targets: same or better behavioural coverage; reported test count down to the hundreds; default suite runtime well under a minute; hypothesis added as a dev-only dependency (a justified exception to the stdlib preference, since it never ships in the library).

Constraint: this is a refactor of test code only. Source behaviour must not change. Coverage must be argued, not asserted: the plan must list each deleted grid and the property that replaces it.
data.title: Consolidate tests with property-based and parametric testing
